info.title: credsd daemon API
info.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 over the daemon's Unix socket (carrier `uds`). Methods marked `stdio` are also exposed on the model-facing stdio carrier, which the daemon does not yet serve. Shapes only; behavior is in docs/specs/. See docs/specs/api-contract/.

methods.name: config/get
methods.summary: Read an environment setting.

methods.name: config/set
methods.summary: Set an environment setting.

schema.description: A setting key such as `region` or `sdk.endpoint_url`.

methods.name: config/unset
methods.summary: Remove an environment setting.
methods.description: Gated. Unsetting an absent key succeeds without a challenge.

methods.name: credential/get
methods.summary: Material for one credential.

params.name: credential
params.description: Absent means the environment's default credential. A credential the environment does not reach fails as ENVIRONMENT_NOT_FOUND.

methods.name: credential/get_batch
methods.summary: Material for every credential an environment names, all or none.
methods.description: Any member failure fails the whole request without naming the member.

methods.name: credential/list
methods.summary: Enumerate the caller's credentials. No material.

methods.name: credential/remove
methods.summary: Remove a credential and its sealed material.

methods.name: environment/bootstrap
methods.summary: Provision a credential and its environment.

params.name: credential
params.description: Absent means a credential named after the environment.

methods.description: Gated only when it would replace existing state; re-sent after approval.

methods.name: environment/describe
methods.summary: An environment's manifest. No material.

methods.name: environment/import
methods.summary: Seal discovered static-key profiles in one batch.
methods.description: One outcome per submitted profile, in order. Gated when it would replace existing state.

methods.name: environment/login
methods.summary: Re-authenticate a credential from its saved provider config.

methods.name: environment/remove
methods.summary: Remove an environment.

methods.name: file/revalidate
methods.summary: Ratify hand-edited, deleted, or unverifiable config files.
methods.description: Succeeds with nothing to do when both files verify; otherwise gated.

methods.name: presence/enroll
methods.summary: Enroll a presence key; raises the approval that installs it.

schema.description: Hex SEC1 uncompressed P-256 public key.

methods.name: presence/revoke
methods.summary: Revoke the caller's enrolled presence key.

methods.name: presence/status
methods.summary: The caller's presence enrollment.

methods.name: request/approve
methods.summary: Approve a pending gated operation.

schema.description: Hex DER ECDSA signature. Absent for a privileged approval.

methods.name: request/get
methods.summary: One pending request.

methods.name: request/list
methods.summary: Pending requests visible to the caller.

methods.name: request/withdraw
methods.summary: Withdraw the caller's own pending request.

methods.name: system/health
methods.summary: Protocol handshake and liveness.

protocol.description: Wire protocol version. Equals the major of info.version.

version.description: Daemon build version. Not an API version.

digest.description: Hex SHA-256 of the pending operation's canonical form.

description.description: What approving authorizes. Rendered to the approver.

oneOf.description: Fingerprint of the owner's enrolled presence key.

Claim.description: Self-reported caller identity claim. Its presence is the assertion; unrecognised values are ignored.

CliSettings.description: AWS CLI settings an environment projects. Absent members are omitted.

CredentialSourceType.description: Provider that issues a credential. Unrecognised values read as unsupported.

CredentialType.description: Kind of material a credential yields.

IdentityType.description: Identity tier of the credential. Absent means `human`.

name.description: Credential and environment name. Validated per entry: an invalid name is a skipped outcome, not a params error.

identity_type.description: Identity tier of the credential. Absent means `human`.

Material.description: Credential material, tagged by `type`. Further variants may be added.

Name.description: An environment or credential name: ASCII letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', at most 64 characters, not starting with '.', and not `default`. Validated at deserialization; a violation is INVALID_PARAMS.

OkResult.description: The method succeeded; nothing to return.

ProfileManifest.description: An environment's manifest. Contains no material.

ProgressParams.description: A step of an interactive bootstrap or login, tagged by `type`.

projections.description: Projection declarations keyed by credential name. Omitted when empty.

ProjectionDecl.description: A projection declaration, `<type>[:<address>]`, where `<type>` is a ProjectionType.

ProjectionType.description: How a credential is delivered to a consumer.

Provenance.description: Whether material was served from the shared cache or minted for this request.

Identity tier of the credential. Absent means `human`.

cert_der.description: Base64 DER of the leaf certificate.

key_der.description: Base64 DER of the private key.

key_tag.description: PEM tag of the key format.

ProviderParams.description: Provider parameters, tagged by `type`. An unrecognised type is refused by the handler.

RefusalReason.description: Why an approval did not satisfy its challenge.

RequestId.description: Caller-supplied correlation id, opaque to the daemon.

Scope.description: Caller-supplied session policy that can only narrow. The grammar is not settled; any JSON value is carried. Absence means boundary-scoped, never unscoped. A malformed scope fails the retrieval.

SdkSettings.description: AWS SDK settings an environment projects. Absent members are omitted.

SessionStatus.description: Whether a credential would work right now.

ApprovalRefused.message: The approval did not satisfy the challenge.

ApprovalRequired.message: The operation is gated; it was not performed.

AuthTimeout.message: Interactive sign-in did not complete in time.

ConfigDrifted.message: config.toml or credentials.toml has drifted from its sealed snapshot.

CustodyBroken.message: Custody of the integrity record or enrolled-key registry is broken.

EnvironmentNotFound.message: No such environment or credential is visible to the caller.

IntegrityUnverifiable.message: The caller's integrity record cannot be opened.

Internal.message: A domain failure with no more specific code.

InvalidParams.message: Params do not match the method's schema.

MethodNotFound.message: Unknown method, or not exposed on this carrier.

ProviderUnavailable.message: The credential provider could not be reached.

RequestNotFound.message: No pending request by that id is visible.

WrongCredentialType.message: The credential's kind cannot be projected onto the requested shape.

x-notifications.name: environment/bootstrap/respond
x-notifications.summary: The user's selection for the step last announced (account, role, or MFA code).

x-notifications.name: notifications/progress
x-notifications.summary: A step of an in-flight bootstrap or login.
